name: bizplug-hvac
description: The hvac & heating/cooling plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: instant estimate and service visit request. It works from the business's own published profile, covering service areas, emergencies, maintenance plans and quotes, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
